lifter.notes: Also: kickboxing (Tue), krav (Sat + 1-2 weeknight), pickleball (1-3x/wk). Bodyweight not yet recorded — fill for bodyweight-load context.

capabilities.notes: Use the wide-grip lat pulldown (load below bodyweight, progressively overload). Re-test BW pull-ups every 2-3 wks; swap back to weighted pull-up at 8+ clean.

capabilities.current: cannot perform a kneeling ab-wheel rollout
capabilities.notes: Progression: dead-bug/plank -> stability-ball or TRX fallout (partial ROM, scale by reach) -> kneeling ab-wheel -> standing. Has 2 TRX + stability balls.

new_exercises.name: Stability-Ball Rollout (Anti-Extension)
new_exercises.rom_notes: forearms on the ball, roll out as far as you can keep a braced neutral spine; scale ROM to ability
new_exercises.cues: brace, posterior pelvic tilt, resist lumbar extension, roll only as far as you can hold neutral

new_exercises.name: TRX / Suspension Fallout (Anti-Extension)
new_exercises.rom_notes: straps short, lean/reach the arms overhead-forward; difficulty scaled by foot position (more horizontal = harder)
new_exercises.regional_bias: whole rectus + bracing erectors (anti-extension); harder than ball, easier than ab-wheel
new_exercises.cues: ribs down, squeeze glutes, brace, no lumbar sag; regress by standing more upright
